Interface RSC

All Known Subinterfaces:
SsComponent
All Known Implementing Classes:
DateTimeField, Field, NumberField, SimpleRSC, SsCheckBox, SsComboBox1, SsComboBox2, SsCurrencyField, SsDateField, SsDbComboBox2, SsFormattedTextField, SsImage, SsIntegerField, SsLabel, SsList1, SsNumericField, SsPercentField, SsSlider, SsSSNField, SsTextArea, SsTextField, SsTimeField, SsTimestampField
public interface RSC
This interface is an accessor to a RowSet and one of its columns; it is extended by SsComponent. Some components, in particular SsTable, have multiple columns; this interface allows a lightweight object to provide row set access for a specified column. Many methods can declare a RSC parameter instead of a SsComponent.
